metric: Unweighted average nDCG@10 across the 15 classic BEIR retrieval datasets, computed directly from MTEB's own raw per-dataset results file
label: MTEB Retrieval (classic BEIR-15, computed)
note: Downloaded directly from the MTEB project's own GitHub repo (embeddings-benchmark/leaderboard — the actual maintainers, not a mirror) and averaged the per-dataset ndcg_at_10 fields across the 15 classic BEIR retrieval sets for every model with full 15/15 coverage. This cached results file only covers model vintages through roughly early 2025 (no Qwen3-Embedding/Gemini-Embedding/current Cohere), which is why it's a separate, older-vintage source alongside embeddings-mteb-technical-reports.json rather than merged into it.
